article.title: Spatiotemporal evolution of the 2011 Prague, Oklahoma, aftershock sequence revealed using subspace detection and relocation
article.scientific_question: Lower magnitude of completeness and resolve the spatiotemporal geometry of the Meeker–Prague/Wilzetta fault system, including shallow Arbuckle Group seismicity.
article.sequence: Induced/triggered 2011 Prague sequence; Mw 4.8 foreshock, Mw 5.7 mainshock and Mw 4.8 largest aftershock.
article.catalog_relationship: Genuine S-phase subspace-detection and Bayesloc relocation catalog; article final quality-filtered population and distributed USGS release are distinct products.

catalog.quality_tier_detail: Enhanced S-phase detection and relocation; uncertainty-filtered subset is useful as a Q1 location anchor.

construction_workflow.summary: A 998-event manually reviewed seed catalog drives station-specific S-phase multichannel subspace detectors; detections are associated, merged with original large-event P/S phases, located with Bayesloc and filtered by uncertainty.

input_data.name: Prague temporary/permanent waveforms
input_data.channels_sampling: Multichannel S-phase templates; exact sample metadata requires SI.
input_data.availability_conditions: 21 temporary + 9 TA + 1 OK; last temporary stations fully operational 2011-11-11.

input_data.name: McNamara velocity model
input_data.availability_conditions: Exact model parameters require supporting files.

stages.name: S-phase subspace detector construction
stages.purpose: Represent station-specific waveform energy with a reduced multichannel template basis.
stages.method: 11–91 multichannel templates per station representing about 90% waveform energy.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Exact numerical detection threshold is not exposed in main text.
stages.dependencies: Station-specific operation starts and template coverage.

stages.name: continuous S-phase detection
stages.purpose: Detect waveform-consistent S arrivals over the study interval.
stages.method: Station-specific continuous correlation from deployment/start dates through 2011-12-05.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Threshold deliberately high but exact value requires missing SI.
Large Mw>3 events can be missed by small-event S templates.

stages.name: association and Bayesloc location
stages.purpose: Group arrivals into events and estimate hypocenters.
inputs: original P/S phases for large events
outputs: 20,788 associated events at >=5 stations; 21,786 located events (article-reported)
stages.method: Arrival-time association followed by Bayesloc with McNamara velocity model.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Retained associated set requires observations at >=5 stations.
stages.analyst_intervention: Original P/S phases merged for large events.

stages.name: uncertainty filtering and release merge
stages.purpose: Retain high-quality hypocenters and merge with original catalog.
outputs: article final 5,262 events; local broader 5,446 E release
stages.method: Epicentral uncertainty <0.5 km and depth uncertainty <1 km; final paper accounting excludes 184 original events failing criteria.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Article filter and release population must remain separate.
stages.dependencies: Row-level uncertainty fields not exposed in current E file.

construction_workflow.final_output: Article final 5,262-event catalog is not byte-identical to local 5,446-E release; local benchmark uses 2,384 E rows in the Prague v1 time window.
